title: Settings
subtitle: Organisation profile, dashboard style, regional formats, attendance, synchronisation, integrations, reports, notifications, security and subscription.

general.title: Organisation profile
general.hint: Names shown across the app and on reports.

regional.title: Region & language
regional.hint: The organisation timezone is the default for branches and for dates shown in the app.
regional.weeklyOffHint: Default for branches and employees without their own setting.
regional.formatsHint: How dates and times are displayed.

attendance.title: Attendance processing
attendance.hint: Defaults for the attendance engine. Detailed rules live in attendance rule sets.
attendance.defaultShiftHint: Used when no shift is assigned to an employee.
attendance.processingDelayHint: Wait after a punch before recalculating the day, to batch bursts of punches.
attendance.cutoffDayHint: 1–28, used when the period is a custom cut-off.
attendance.selfServiceHint: Employees with a linked user can request corrections to their own attendance.

selfServiceCheckIn.title: Self-service check-in
selfServiceCheckIn.hint: Rules for check-ins from the employee portal and the mobile app. Device punches are not affected.
selfServiceCheckIn.geofenceHint: What happens to a self-service punch taken outside the employee's geofence.
selfServiceCheckIn.outOfWindowHint: What happens to a self-service punch outside its check-in / check-out window.
selfServiceCheckIn.windowHint: Local time. Leave both empty for any time of day.
selfServiceCheckIn.ipAllowListHint: One address or CIDR block per line. Empty = any network. Enforced only when the API runs behind the configured edge (EDGE_SHARED_SECRET): without it a list cannot be saved, and one saved earlier is ignored.
selfServiceCheckIn.duplicateSecondsHint: A second self-service punch within this many seconds is treated as a duplicate.
selfServiceCheckIn.regularisationHint: Employees ask to fix a missed or wrong punch, unmarked work from home or a system downtime. Each request is decided through approvals, and the approved change is applied on the approver’s behalf.
selfServiceCheckIn.channelNote: Web and mobile check-in follow the channel the app reports: they decide what the apps offer, but they are not a security control. Location, geofences, the IP allow-list and the time windows are what the server enforces.

missedPunch.title: Missed punches and day close
missedPunch.hint: The day close reviews each working day once the grace period has passed.
missedPunch.detectionHint: Days with a missing check-in or check-out need an explanation like absences and late arrivals.
missedPunch.graceDaysHint: 0–7 days after a day before the day close looks at it.
missedPunch.splitTimeHint: A lone punch before this time counts as a check-in, after it as a check-out.

nonWorkingDay.title: Work on weekly offs and holidays
nonWorkingDay.hint: How hours worked on a weekly off or a public holiday are counted. With overtime, the rule set's weekly-off / holiday overtime switches still apply.
nonWorkingDay.action: Hours worked on a non-working day

unexcused.title: Unexcused days
unexcused.hint: An absence, late arrival or missed punch that is still unexplained after the grace period is marked unexcused.
unexcused.autoDeductHint: The pay effect is charged to paid leave first, then as loss of pay. When off, days are only marked.
unexcused.graceDaysHint: 0–30 days an employee has to explain a day before it is marked unexcused.
unexcused.payEffectLate: Pay effect of a late arrival
unexcused.payEffectMissingPunch: Pay effect of a missed punch
unexcused.priorityHint: Leave type codes, comma-separated. Then the paid leave type with the most balance left.
unexcused.excludeHint: Leave type codes, comma-separated (sick, maternity, paternity and Hajj by default).

notes.title: Attendance notes
notes.hint: Whether employees must give a reason when they explain a day in the portal.
notes.requireLate: Require a reason for a late arrival
notes.requireAbsent: Require a reason for an absence

stats.title: Statistics
stats.hint: Targets behind the employee's own attendance statistics.

sync.title: Device synchronisation
sync.hint: Polling cadence and automatic pushes. Device-specific overrides live on each device.
sync.offlineThresholdHint: Minutes without contact before a device is marked offline.
sync.reconciliationHint: Full comparison of device users vs. employees.
sync.adaptiveHint: Poll more often during busy hours and back off when idle.
sync.autoPushHint: Queue a device push when an employee is created or changed.
sync.maxSkewHint: Punches with a larger device clock skew are quarantined.

integrations.noPermission: You need the integration.manage permission to configure integrations.
integrations.title: Flowza Finance
integrations.hint: Two-way attendance sync with Flowza Finance (HR+). One virtual device registered in Finance — its serial and push token — carries both directions: Finance punches are pulled into FlowZa Time and FlowZa Time punches are pushed to Finance. Pulled punches are never pushed back.
integrations.enabledHint: When off, nothing is pulled or pushed; the settings and the stored token are kept.
integrations.baseUrlHint: https only. attendance-export and attendance-ingest are called under this address.
integrations.deviceSerialHint: The serial of the virtual device registered in Finance, e.g. FLOWZA-TIME-<company code>.
integrations.tokenHint: Shown in Finance when the device is registered. Stored encrypted; it is never displayed again.
integrations.directionHint: Pull brings Finance punches in, push sends FlowZa Time punches out.
integrations.pinKeyHint: The employee field sent to Finance as the PIN and matched when pulling. Finance maps PIN = employee number unless a PIN mapping says otherwise.
integrations.pollMinutesHint: {{min}}–{{max}} minutes between pulls and between pushes.
integrations.statusHint: Last pull and push, failures and punches that could not be matched to an employee.
integrations.unmatchedHint: Pulled punches with no matching employee — open to triage.
integrations.circuit: Calls to Finance are paused after repeated failures ({{state}}); next attempt {{at}}.
integrations.syncFromHint: Punches before this date are never synchronised in either direction; the first pull and the first push start here. Moving it earlier re-reads Finance and re-sends FlowZa Time punches from the new date (both sides skip duplicates).
integrations.syncFromFuture: The start date cannot be in the future.
integrations.disconnectHint: The connector stops, its Finance token is deleted and its sync position is cleared. Punches already exchanged stay where they are. To reconnect, enter a push token and save.
integrations.pushRetry: Finance rejected punches of the last push batch; it is being retried (attempt {{attempts}} of {{max}}, then it is skipped and reported).

notifications.title: Organisation notifications
notifications.hint: Which events create in-app notifications for administrators.
notifications.syncFailedHint: A sync job or item failed after retries.
notifications.approvalPendingHint: A correction or leave request awaits approval.
notifications.dailyDigestHint: One summary per day instead of individual alerts.

security.title: Security policy
security.hint: Applies to every member of this organisation.
security.mfaRequiredHint: Members without MFA are blocked from the API until they enrol.
security.exportReasonHint: Exports of employee data must include a reason (audited).
security.domainsHint: Comma-separated. Leave empty to allow any domain for invitations.

mfa.title: Your two-factor authentication
mfa.hint: Protect your own account with an authenticator app (TOTP).
mfa.noneHint: Add an authenticator to require a 6-digit code at sign-in.
mfa.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the secret manually, then type the 6-digit code.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
mfa.removeHint: If your organisation requires MFA you will need to enrol again before using the app.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.hint: Plan, status and limits for this organisation. Changes are handled by FlowZa support.
subscription.unavailable: Subscription details are not available here yet
subscription.unavailableHint: Your organisation is {{status}}. Contact support for plan details.
subscription.limitsHint: Usage against the limits of your plan.

reports.title: Reports
reports.hint: How generated reports print hours and attendance codes. Applies to every report this organisation produces.
reports.hoursNotationHint: Tot Hrs, OT and UT columns. 9.45 means nine hours forty-five minutes.
reports.defaultFormatHint: Pre-selected when a report is requested.
reports.showLegendHint: The "NOTE : ATTENDANCE CODE" footer under attendance reports.
reports.codesHint: Leave days print the leave type’s own code; these cover the other statuses. Leave a box blank to keep the default shown.

dashboard.title: Dashboard style
dashboard.hint: How the dashboard and the app look for everyone in this organisation. Your choice is previewed as you click and applied for all members when you save.
dashboard.styleHint: Colours of the sidebar, buttons and charts.
dashboard.layoutHint: Which widgets the dashboard shows, and what comes first.
dashboard.trendDaysHint: Days shown by the attendance trend chart.
dashboard.showGreetingHint: “Good morning, Hassan” with the organisation name, instead of the plain page title.
dashboard.showQuoteHint: A short quote about time and discipline in the side rail (Overview and Operations layouts).
dashboard.showHighlightHint: The headline card with a link to reports, at the top of the side rail (Overview and Operations layouts).
dashboard.previewing: Previewing “{{name}}”. Save to apply it for everyone, or reset to go back to the saved style.
dashboard.readOnlyHint: Only administrators with the organisation permission can change the style. Ask them if you would like a different look.

emerald.name: FlowZa Green
emerald.hint: The signature look: deep green sidebar, emerald accents.

midnight.name: Midnight Indigo
midnight.hint: Navy sidebar with indigo and violet accents and gradient bars.

classic.name: Classic Light
classic.hint: White sidebar and blue accents — airy and minimal.

desert.name: Desert Gold
desert.hint: Warm sand and bronze tones with a deep brown sidebar.

ocean.name: Ocean Teal
ocean.hint: Deep teal sidebar with turquoise accents.

graphite.name: Graphite
graphite.hint: Charcoal and neutral greys; colour is kept for the data.

crimson.name: Crimson
crimson.hint: Maroon sidebar and red accents for red-branded companies.

overview.name: Overview
overview.hint: Balanced: today's numbers, the trend, branches, recent activity, approvals and holidays.

operations.name: Operations
operations.hint: Devices, sync jobs and today's punches first — for attendance and IT teams.

executive.name: Executive
executive.hint: Compact: headline numbers with sparklines, the trend and branches. No side rail.
